title: Lower ME: Hinge
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Reverse Lunge × 6/side · Hamstring Walkout × 5 · 4 Way Deadbug × 4
jumps: Trap Bar Deadlift 3 · 5-sec lower @ RPE 7.5 → Broad Jump 4 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Eccentric wk 2: heavier, 5 sec down · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
strength: Hold a rack if you need balance

cond.subtitle: Hard 1:00, easy 1:30
cond.scaling: Machines taken? Run outside, same times

note: Eccentric wk 2: more weight on the bar, 5-second lowering. Write down your heavy-step weight.
